entries.title: Fewer short pauses when a task closes or a card is read
entries.body: The app no longer stops answering for a moment when a task closes or once an hour while it decides which closed tasks' files to keep. Looking up one task's answered cards, as a review or a new task's brief does, no longer reads every answered card first.
entries.noPicture: This shortens two reads the app does in the background, with no changed view or control.
